description: a rod filling a tube's bore (coaxial-fuse's contact at the band survey's numbers), turned about its middle so its ends move a quarter of a tolerance (2.5e-8) against the bore's wall: the two walls, coincident at the contact, are now a skew pair within a tolerance of each other everywhere. Arris fails: a section edge crosses a seam without a pave there (Fault::Seam). The desired result is the flush body, the full cylinder (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey)
